description: This file defines the DashboardScreen widget and its associated components for a Flutter app, including UI elements like header, hero promo card, featured tiles, curated list, and bottom navigation bar. It recreates a specific dark-themed dashboard interface as per design notes.

classes.name: DashboardScreen
classes.description: Main widget representing the dashboard screen, maintaining selected navigation index and building the overall layout.

classes.name: _HeaderRow
classes.description: Widget for displaying the header row with greeting and action icons.

classes.name: _HeaderTextBlock
classes.description: Widget for textual greeting messages in header.

classes.name: _CircleOutlineIconButton
classes.description: Reusable circular icon button with outline border.

classes.name: _HeroPromoCard
classes.description: Widget for creating the hero promotional banner with gradient background and custom star decoration.

classes.name: _HeroStarPainter
classes.description: Custom painter that draws a starburst decoration on the hero promo card.

classes.name: _SectionTitle
classes.description: Simple widget for section titles within the dashboard.

classes.name: _FeaturedTilesRow
classes.description: Row of featured tiles with icons and labels.

classes.name: _FeaturedTile
classes.description: Individual feature tile with icon and label.

classes.name: _CuratedHorizontalList
classes.description: Horizontal list of curated cards, each with gradient background and optional close icon.

classes.name: _CuratedCard
classes.description: Decorative card with gradient background and overlay 'X' icon to simulate curated content.

classes.name: _BottomNavBar
classes.description: Custom bottom navigation bar with five items, highlighting the center item.

classes.name: _NavIcon
classes.description: Icon widget for navigation items, indicating selected state.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for DashboardScreen, assembling the entire dashboard layout.
